## Project Overview
Coralys/UltraCrew platform — airline crew scheduling and compliance system. Rust backend (adapters, services), React frontend (ultracrew-pilot-portal), GERAD G2014-22 benchmark integration. Working in `/Users/nikhil/ChronoSentiment_MEGA_FINAL` on branch `governance-hardening`.

## Completed Work

**Portal UI & Gantt (Reminders 1–11):** All completed. Full 6-step portal UI flow working with GERAD benchmark (385 duties, 22 workers, 724h horizon). Gantt chart shows layover/deadhead/FDP violation markers, worker qualifications in row labels, correct legend, backend endpoints wired.

**UC-ARCH-001 Credit Framework (Reminders 12–19):** All 7 phases implemented and committed.
- Phase 1+2: `credit.rs` — CreditPolicyMetadata, CreditContext, CreditComponents, DutyCredit, CreditPolicy trait, GeradCreditPolicy
- Phase 3: `cost.rs` — CostContext, DutyCost, CostModel trait, FlatRateCostModel
- Phase 4+5: `roster_metrics.rs` — DutyRecord, RosterMetrics, aggregate_roster_credits(), BaseCreditFloor
- Phase 6: `objective.rs` — CreditedHoursBalanceObjective (variance of credited hours across crew)
- Phase 7: `objective.rs` — CreditCostObjective (total monetary credit cost)
- `domain/mod.rs`: exports all public types
- 217 tests (197 unit + 4 benchmark + 3 robustness + 1 scalability + 11 scenario + 1 solution-quality), 0 failures
- Committed as: `feat(coralys-airline): implement UC-ARCH-001 Credit Framework phases 1-7`

**Batch 3 commit (governance-hardening branch):** `chore: add adapters/gerad and ultracrew compliance module`
- 29 files, 3111 insertions
- `adapters/gerad/`: Cargo.toml, src/{error,importer,lib,mapper,models,parser,validator}.rs, tests/fixtures/*.csv, tests/integration_import.rs
- `adapters/ultracrew/src/compliance/`: agreements/mod.rs, company/mod.rs, metadata.rs, mod.rs, optimization/mod.rs, registry.rs, regulatory/dgca/{flight_hours,limits,maximum_fdp,minimum_rest,mod,standby}.rs, regulatory/mod.rs, tests.rs, traits.rs

## Key Technical Decisions

- **Credit policy**: GeradCreditPolicy: `credit = flight_time + 0.5 × deadhead_time` (Quesnel et al. s1; briefing/debriefing excluded)
- **Cost model**: FlatRateCostModel: `cost = credited_hours × pay_rate_per_hour`
- **FDP limit**: 13.0 hours (EASA ORO.FTL.205 base limit)
- **Compliance engine**: FdpComplianceEngine checks each duty against FDP limit
- **Server**: Axum-based HTTP server on port 8080 with in-memory schedule state (Arc<RwLock<Option<ScheduleResult>>>)
- **CLI**: clap-based with `fdp` and `credits` subcommands
- **GERAD epoch**: 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z; duties parsed from start_hour/end_hour offsets
- **Batched git commits** by directory/module to keep history clean

## Relevant Files & Code

**`adapters/airline/src/domain/duty.rs`** — Duty, FlightLeg, Pairing structs; `compute_credit<P: CreditPolicy>` and `total_credited_hours` methods

**`adapters/airline/src/optimization/neighborhood/swap.rs`** — `evaluate_swap_delta` and `evaluate_swap_delta_default` using GeradCreditPolicy

**`adapters/ultracrew/src/bin/ultracrew-cli.rs`** — CLI with `fdp` (FDP compliance check) and `credits` (roster credit metrics) subcommands

**`adapters/ultracrew/src/lib.rs`** — Re-exports: FdpComplianceEngine, CreditPolicy types, CostModel types, RosterMetrics, ScheduleResult

**`services/ultracrew_server/src/main.rs`** — Axum server: GET /health, POST /api/schedule, GET /api/credits, GET /api/compliance

**`adapters/ultracrew/src/compliance/mod.rs`** — FdpComplianceEngine, FdpViolation, ComplianceReport; MAX_FDP_HOURS=13.0

**`adapters/gerad/src/`** — GeradInstanceParser, GeradDuty/Worker/Instance types; JSON parsing with start_hour/end_hour offsets from epoch

**`benchmarks/gerad-g2014-22/`** — GERAD G2014-22 instance (385 duties, 22 workers, 724h horizon, skills: CPT/FO/FA)

**`apps/ultracrew-pilot-portal/`** — React app: App.js, GanttChart.js, StepWizard.js; public/geradInstance1.js
